ozoneGenerators.name: High-Frequency Ceramic Dielectric Barrier Discharge (DBD) Plasma Generator (Pure O₂ Feed, 50-250 ppm)
ozoneGenerators.classification: Industrial Aseptic Corona DBD Reactor (ASME / UL 867 / CSA C22.2)
ozoneGenerators.coolingType: Chilled Deionized Water Loop (15°C Closed Circuit)
ozoneGenerators.description: State-of-the-art micro-gap ceramic dielectric barrier discharge cell fed by medical-grade pure oxygen. Generates high-density cold atmospheric plasma producing concentrated ozone gas with virtually zero nitrogen oxide (NOx) acid byproducts, ensuring food-grade surface sanitation.

ozoneGenerators.name: Heavy-Duty Corona Discharge Tubular Generator with PSA Desiccant Air Prep (40-120 ppm)
ozoneGenerators.classification: Continuous Industrial Conveyor Sanitizer (NEMA 4X / CE Machinery)
ozoneGenerators.feedGasType: Desiccant-Dried Compressed Ambient Air (Pressure Swing Adsorption, Dewpoint -60°C)
ozoneGenerators.dielectricMaterial: Precision Borosilicate Glass & Stainless Steel Mesh
ozoneGenerators.coolingType: Forced Air Cooling with Air-to-Air Heat Exchanger
ozoneGenerators.description: High-throughput industrial ozone generation skid fed with PSA-treated dried ambient air. Cost-effective for broad conveyor sanitation tunnels and secondary packaging lines, but produces trace nitrogen pentoxide (N₂O₅) requiring humidity-controlled chamber management.

ozoneGenerators.name: Cold UV-C Photochemical Ozone Generator (185 nm Vacuum UV + 254 nm Germicidal)
ozoneGenerators.classification: Gentle Photochemical Non-Plasma Generator (NSF / ANSI Standard 50)
ozoneGenerators.feedGasType: Clean Dry Ambient Air or Filtered Nitrogen-Oxygen Blend
ozoneGenerators.dielectricMaterial: Synthetic High-Purity Suprasil Fused Silica Quartz
ozoneGenerators.description: Non-thermal photochemical ozone generation utilizing high-intensity 185 nm synthetic quartz mercury-amalgam lamps. 100% free of nitrogen oxide byproducts; ideal for organic produce and fragile fruit processing, though limited to lower peak ozone concentrations.

ozoneGenerators.name: Severely Degraded / Cracked Quartz Dielectric Corona Generator (Dielectric Flashover & NOx Leakage)
ozoneGenerators.classification: HAZARDOUS / NON-COMPLIANT (OSHA 29 CFR § 1910.1000 / Severe Fugitive Ozone Release)
ozoneGenerators.feedGasType: Moist Unfiltered Ambient Air (Dewpoint > -10°C, Oil Mist Contaminated)
ozoneGenerators.description: Severely compromised ozone generator operating with cracked dielectric tubes and contaminated air feed. High humidity causes nitric acid (HNO₃) condensation, electrical flashover sparking, rapid drop in ozone yield, and dangerous occupational fugitive emissions.

conveyorSubstrates.name: Dry Bakery Contact Conveyor & Corrugated Aseptic Carton Sleeves (Low Moisture Film, RH 45%)
conveyorSubstrates.substrateType: Dry Cellulosic & Barrier Coated Packaging Material
conveyorSubstrates.description: Continuous carton blanks and bakery package conveyor. Gaseous ozone provides complete non-aqueous surface sterilization without wetting or softening corrugated packaging, preserving mechanical box crush strength.

conveyorSubstrates.name: Fresh Post-Harvest Berries, Table Grapes & Citrus Fruit (Delicate Natural Cuticular Wax)
conveyorSubstrates.description: Continuous roller-conveyor carrying freshly harvested berries and citrus fruit. Inactivates post-harvest green mold (Penicillium) and Botrytis cinerea fungal spores. Requires strict ppm limits to prevent epidermal browning and calyx bleaching.

conveyorSubstrates.name: Raw Poultry Breast & Fresh Primal Meat Sanitary Intralox Belting (High Organic Load & Moisture)
conveyorSubstrates.substrateType: Cold Biological Muscle Tissue & Modular Plastic Belting
conveyorSubstrates.description: Sanitary food-contact conveyor belt transporting raw poultry cutlets. High organic surface moisture rapidly quenches ozone gas into aqueous radicals, requiring higher gas CT exposure to achieve thorough Salmonella and Campylobacter surface reduction without lipid rancidity.

conveyorSubstrates.name: Severely Pitted Polyurethane / Neoprene Rubber Belt (Micro-Crack Biofilm Harborages)
conveyorSubstrates.substrateType: HAZARDOUS / DEGRADED (Elastomer Ozonolysis Stress Cracking & Biofilm Reservoir)
conveyorSubstrates.surfacePorosity: Deep Fissures (>500 µm) & Pitted Rubber Matrix
conveyorSubstrates.description: Compromised, aged conveyor belting suffering from severe ozone-induced elastomer chain scission (ozonolysis). Deep micro-cracks shelter spore biofilms from gaseous contact while shedding rubber particulate directly into food product streams.

targetMicroorganisms.name: Aspergillus niger Conidiospores (Black Mold, High Melanin Spore Coat Pigment)
targetMicroorganisms.description: Airborne fungal conidia responsible for severe food spoilage and fruit rot. Thick melanin pigment in outer spore coats acts as a potent free-radical scavenger, requiring high CT values and >80% relative humidity to induce oxidative envelope rupture.

targetMicroorganisms.name: Clostridium botulinum Type E / C. perfringens Endospores (Anaerobic Bacterial Spores)
targetMicroorganisms.description: Highly recalcitrant bacterial endospores containing dipicolinic acid (DPA) cross-linked core. Spore coats must be swollen by elevated chamber humidity to enable gaseous ozone to penetrate into the inner spore membrane and oxidize respiratory enzymes.

targetMicroorganisms.name: Bacillus cereus Foodborne Endospores (Emetic & Diarrheal Spore Former)
targetMicroorganisms.description: Prevalent soil-borne spore former common on grains, pasta, and dry bakery machinery. Gaseous ozone oxidizes the multi-layered protein spore coat and attacks peptidoglycan crosslinks, rendering endospores non-viable.

targetMicroorganisms.name: Penicillium digitatum Post-Harvest Citrus Green Mold Conidia
targetMicroorganisms.description: Major post-harvest wound pathogen affecting citrus fruit packing lines. Rapidly inactivated by moderate ozone CT exposures, extending cold-chain commercial shelf life without chemical synthetic fungicide residues.

offGasDestructionSystems.name: Heated Manganese Dioxide - Copper Oxide (Hopcalite) Catalytic Honeycomb Destruct Unit
offGasDestructionSystems.catalystType: Pelletized / Honeycomb MnO₂ (70%) - CuO (30%) Active Matrix
offGasDestructionSystems.exhaustComplianceStandard: OSHA 29 CFR § 1910.1000 (<0.10 ppm TWA / <0.05 ppm ACGIH TLV)
offGasDestructionSystems.description: Thermally assisted dual-metal oxide catalytic destructor. Converts exhaust ozone directly into pure diatomic oxygen (2 O₃ → 3 O₂) with zero toxic emissions. Integrated preheater prevents catalyst moisture condensation at elevated relative humidity.

offGasDestructionSystems.name: High-Temperature Electric Thermal Decomposition Oxidizer Chamber (>350°C)
offGasDestructionSystems.exhaustComplianceStandard: OSHA Table Z-1 (<0.02 ppm Workplace Ambient Exhaust)
offGasDestructionSystems.description: Ultra-reliable thermal destruction unit operating well above the thermal auto-dissociation temperature of ozone (300°C). Immune to catalyst poisoning or airborne sulfur/chlorine deactivation, but requires higher continuous electrical energy input.

offGasDestructionSystems.name: Moisture-Saturated Activated Carbon Scrubber with Damper Channelling (Breakthrough Risk)
offGasDestructionSystems.catalystType: HAZARDOUS / SATURATED (Virgin Bituminous Granular Carbon, Moisture Poisoned)
offGasDestructionSystems.exhaustComplianceStandard: NON-COMPLIANT (Fugitive Ozone Breakthrough > 0.8 ppm; Auto-Ignition Thermal Runaway Risk)
offGasDestructionSystems.description: Compromised carbon adsorption bed suffering from severe humidity poisoning and internal gas channeling. Exothermic ozone oxidation on carbon surfaces creates severe hot spots with potential for smoldering bed fires, while venting dangerous ozone fumes into operator workspace.
